description: This file implements a Bitfield class in JavaScript, including methods for bit manipulation, buffer conversion, and internal page management. It leverages an external 'memory-pager' module for page handling.

classes.name: Bitfield
classes.description: A class representing a bitfield with methods for setting, getting, and converting bits to buffers, managing internal pages, and handling dynamic buffer resizing.

methods.name: Bitfield
methods.description: Constructor function for creating a new Bitfield instance with options for page size, offset, buffer initialization, and tracking updates.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific bit at position i.

methods.name: getByte
methods.description: Retrieves the byte at a specific index in the internal pages.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets or clears a specific bit at position i based on the value v.

methods.name: toBuffer
methods.description: Converts the entire bitfield into a single Buffer object.

methods.name: setByte
methods.description: Sets the byte at a specific index within the internal pages.
